name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)

eligibility.land_ownership: Must own cultivable agricultural land (any size)
exclusions: families with any member who is/was a constitutional post holder, minister, MP, MLA
families with any member who is an income-tax payee in the last assessment year
families with any member drawing a monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more (except MTS/Class IV/Group D employees)
eligibility.state_restriction: All states except where local land records are not digitized

benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000, transferred directly to bank account
application_process: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centre (CSC) or local revenue/agriculture officer

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)

eligibility.crop_type: Must be a notified crop for the notified area for that season
eligibility.land_ownership: Both landowner and tenant/sharecropper farmers eligible with proper documentation

benefit: Insurance cover against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, diseases. Premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops; balance subsidized by government
application_process: Apply through bank (if loanee, automatic), CSC, insurance company portal, or pmfby.gov.in before the cutoff date for that crop season

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)

farmer_type: joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
SHGs or joint liability groups of farmers
eligibility.land_ownership: Not mandatory for tenant farmers/sharecroppers if proper certification available

benefit: Short-term credit up to Rs 3 lakh at subsidized interest (effective ~4% with prompt repayment incentive), covers crop production, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities
application_process: Apply at any nationalized/cooperative/regional rural bank branch or via KCC saturation drives

name: Soil Health Card Scheme

eligibility.land_ownership: Any landholding size, ownership not verified strictly

benefit: Free soil testing every 2 years with crop-wise fertilizer and nutrient recommendations to improve yield and reduce input cost
application_process: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agriculture department office, or register at soilhealth.dac.gov.in

name: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana) - Micro Irrigation

farmer_type: large farmers with own or leased land
eligibility.land_ownership: Land ownership or valid lease document required

benefit: Subsidy of 55% (small/marginal) or 45% (other farmers) on drip/sprinkler irrigation equipment cost
documents_required: quotation from empanelled irrigation equipment supplier
application_process: Apply through state horticulture/agriculture department portal or district agriculture office

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefit: Online trading platform giving access to pan-India buyers, transparent price discovery, reduced dependence on local middlemen
application_process: Register at enam.gov.in or through local APMC mandi with e-NAM facility

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs

farmer_type: group of at least 11 farmers willing to form a Farmer Producer Organization

benefit: Financial assistance up to Rs 18 lakh per FPO over 3 years, equity grant up to Rs 15 lakh, credit guarantee up to Rs 2 crore per FPO
documents_required: List of member farmers with Aadhaar
application_process: Apply through Implementing Agencies (SFAC, NABARD, NCDC) or state nodal agency

name: PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana) - Organic Farming

farmer_type: farmers willing to form/join a cluster of minimum 20 hectares (50 farmers) for organic conversion
eligibility.land_ownership: Own or leased land under cultivation

benefit: Financial assistance of Rs 50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, certification, and value addition
application_process: Apply through state agriculture department or local KVK organic farming cell

name: State Crop Loan Waiver Scheme (varies by state)

farmer_type: small and marginal farmers with outstanding crop loans as of the scheme cutoff date
eligibility.land_ownership: Landholding limit varies by state (commonly up to 5 acres)
eligibility.state_restriction: Only applicable in states that have announced an active waiver scheme; terms vary significantly by state

benefit: Full or partial waiver of outstanding short-term crop loans, amount and cap varies by state (commonly Rs 1-2 lakh cap)
application_process: Automatic verification through bank/cooperative society records, or apply at local revenue office; check specific state agriculture department notification

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PM-FME)

eligibility.land_ownership: Not mandatory, business/processing activity is the criterion

benefit: Credit-linked subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost (max Rs 10 lakh per unit) for upgrading micro food processing enterprises
application_process: Apply through state nodal agency or pmfme.mofpi.gov.in portal

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)

eligibility.land_ownership: Required for the infrastructure project site (owned or leased)

benefit: Interest subvention of 3% on loans up to Rs 2 crore for post-harvest management infrastructure (warehouses, cold storage, etc.), credit guarantee coverage available
application_process: Apply through participating banks or the AIF online portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in)

name: RKVY (Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana)

farmer_type: farmers, FPOs, entrepreneurs proposing agri/allied sector projects under state annual action plan
eligibility.land_ownership: Depends on specific sub-scheme/project component chosen by state

benefit: Varies by state and project component; typically capital subsidy for agri-infrastructure, mechanization, or value chain projects
documents_required: Varies by state; generally Aadhaar, land records, project proposal
application_process: Apply through state agriculture department as per the state's RKVY annual action plan
